*No.1 Adagio and Fugue in D minor: The Fugue is based on WTK I, No.8 in D{{sharp}} minor (J.S. Bach).

I have been given to understand that attribution of these works (original and arrangements—the former as works, the latter as well-done arrangements by a composer who later wrote one of the very earliest and still best substantial works for this instrumental combination) to Mozart while I would agree likely, is not certain - is there manuscript evidence, etc.?
